outcome: excess weight (BMI/Age index and Z score > +2)
cohort: The study involved 664 full-time preschoolers enrolled in public childcare centers in Vitoria da Conquista, Bahia.
finding: Factors associated with excess weight in preschool children included cesarean delivery, being singletons, and exclusive breastfeeding for less than 4 months.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with a 2.59 times higher odds of excess weight in preschool children.
cross-section timing: Preschool age (children attending public childcare centers)
